roomsSource.description:
Ascott Raffles Place Singapore offers an exceptional stay in the vibrant heart of Singapore’s Central Business District (CBD). This distinguished serviced residence is housed within a beautifully restored 1950s heritage structure, showcasing an elegant Art Deco façade that creates a striking contrast against the city’s contemporary skyline. Guests seeking a refined apartment in Singapore will find themselves perfectly positioned for both crucial business engagements and leisurely exploration, with immediate access to a dynamic array of cultural, entertainment, and sophisticated shopping destinations within the CBD and Marina Bay precinct.

Each spacious apartment offers a welcoming, refined sanctuary, featuring modern furnishings and thoughtful amenities for absolute comfort and convenience. Whether you choose a sophisticated studio or an expansive multi-bedroom suite, every detail ensures an elevated residential living experience. Guests benefit from complimentary high-speed wireless internet connectivity, a fully equipped designer kitchen for personalised meal preparation, and a premium BOSE home entertainment system for relaxation. This makes Ascott Raffles Place Singapore an ideal choice for discerning global travellers seeking sophisticated long-stay apartments in Singapore.

The property offers a comprehensive selection of facilities and signature services to enhance your stay. Guests can take a refreshing dip in the stunning infinity swimming pool overlooking the skyline, maintain their fitness routine in the well-appointed gymnasium, or find a quiet moment in The Living Room, our exclusive residents' lounge. For dining, CALI, our on-site restaurant, offers an exceptional all-day menu of Western cuisine, featuring dishes such as succulent braised beef cheeks and gourmet wagyu burgers. Engage with the Ascott Lifestyle through our curated residents' programmes, which focus on culture, gastronomy, and wellness, offering unique opportunities to connect with the city's rich tapestry.

Beyond the private comforts of your apartment, Ascott Raffles Place Singapore provides an array of bespoke services to cater to your every need. Benefit from 24/7 on-call wellness and security, ensuring peace of mind throughout your stay. Our dedicated team provides daily housekeeping services (excluding Sundays and public holidays), alongside convenient laundry and dry cleaning options. We are committed to ensuring comfort for all guests, offering accessible rooms and facilities for those with physical requirements. For those planning an extended visit, we provide a seamless blend of attentive service and residential comfort, ensuring every stay feels like an exceptional home.

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.


Ascott Clean360
Ascott Raffles Place Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here.

Ascott Raffles Place Singapore enjoys an enviable, highly advantageous location in the vibrant heart of Singapore’s Central Business District (CBD). This lively neighbourhood seamlessly blends towering financial institutions with a rich tapestry of cultural landmarks, world-class dining, and exciting entertainment options. Our serviced apartments offer unparalleled access to everything Singapore has to offer, putting you just a short walk from your doorstep. Guests can take a stroll (approximately 5 minutes) to the famous Merlion Park, where one can capture memorable photographs with the city’s mythical mascot. The picturesque Singapore River is also nearby, inviting guests to enjoy a relaxing river cruise past historic Boat Quay and lively Clarke Quay.

Beyond the iconic sights, the immediate precinct offers premier retail and gastronomy. Food enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to Lau Pa Sat (a renowned hawker centre offering authentic local cuisine), which is reachable within a brief walk. Additionally, premier shopping destinations like One Raffles Place and Raffles City Shopping Centre are within easy reach, offering extensive retail therapy and dining options. For panoramic city views, the magnificent Singapore Flyer is easily accessible and offers a truly unforgettable perspective of the skyline. This central location serves as the perfect base to experience the city's dynamic energy, whether your itinerary focuses on business or leisure.

gettingToProperty.description:
By Taxi
From Singapore Changi Airport, the journey takes approximately 25 minutes and costs around SGD 25.

By Mass Rapid Transport (MRT)
Take the MRT to Raffles Place MRT station, which takes approximately 35 minutes. From there, exit from Exit I, turn left following the pathway to Ascott Raffles Place Singapore in 1 minute.

facilityDetails.title: FOR GUESTS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENTS
facilityDetails.description: The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with physical impairments. Accessible rooms are designed for comfort, and safety is prioritized with conveniently located accessible toilets featuring clear emergency instructions. Wheelchair ramps, a dedicated service lift from the ground floor to the main lobby, and standard lifts ensure smooth navigation throughout the property. Our staff are also trained to assist guests with disabilities, ensuring a comfortable and inclusive experience.

facilityDetails.title: FOR GUESTS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENTS
facilityDetails.description:
The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with visual impairments, featuring braille signage in lifts to aid navigation.

Do contact our property if you would like to find out more.
